criteria.requirement: Fix i18n translation cache identity to include locale plus resolved catalog root, including PathLike/relative aliases, using actual GNUTranslations bytes. Extend activate(locale,path=None,*,reload=False) with explicit per-source reload that bypasses gettext stale cache without clearing unrelated sources. Load before changing current state; failure preserves prior selection. Preserve default English/None/deactivate and explicit legacy default _TRANSLATIONS injection, but never let injected/default locale objects shadow an explicit different directory. Demonstrate synthetic real GNU catalogs, source reuse, reload, failure and separator compatibility.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
